services.name: Bear Sightseeing
services.desc: On this custom Denali flightseeing tour your experienced pilot will take you to the heart of the awesome mountain region known as Denali- The Great one. You’ll see, from your exclusive window seat, the Ruth Glacier, Icefall, Climbers Camp, and the Denali mountain summit. Be ready to be speechless as we navigate through the Alaska Mountain Range and explore areas few get to see up close. Enjoy the in-flight music and feel one with this magical place. Envision early explorers and climber first ascents of these vast mountains. You’ll find this place magical like we do. We’ll soar glaciers, see crevasses, and avalanche fields. If you desire we can ‘pull over’ and explore early Alaskan mining

includes: Pilot and staff familiar with local weather, terrain, and logistics
Flight route, timing, and landings planned around best available conditions on day of travel
gap: Duration of each flight not stated
blurb: Guests take scenic flights over Alaska's mountains, glaciers, and national parks, with routes and landings planned around the best available weather and safety conditions. Tours include wildlife viewing and opportunities for photography. Flights operate in areas such as Anchorage, Cook Inlet, Chugach Mountains, Lake Clark National Park, Katmai National Park, and the Alaska Range.

quotes.author: easnewyorkcity
quotes.text: This could not have been better. Dan was a terrific guide and skilled pilot. We felt like family from the get-go. As a foursome with two men over six feet, we managed to fit in the plane comfortably, though quarters are tight. We were graced with perfect weather, smooth flights, and extraordinary views. we saw bears at two locations, easily a dozen of them or more, with a family of three walking comfortably close to us as they dug up clams and then took a nap on the rocks. Lunch was fresh and tasty (sandwiches, macaroni salad; chips, etc), and the outdoor toilets at the two rest stops are clean and private. Everything is thought through and well executed.

quotes.author: Steven Precourt
quotes.text: Absolutely incredible experience flying with Alaska Air to Lake Clark National Park. Lucas, our pilot, was outstanding, friendly, skilled, and clearly passionate about Alaska. The flight was smooth, the views were unbelievable, and Lucas made the whole adventure feel personal and memorable. The views of the bears were amazing, one of the best vacation days ever and a great way to end our trip to Alaska. The team at Alaska Air did a great job in rescheduling the flight to fit our schedule when the first day was cancelled due to weather. If you’re looking for a top tier excursion in Alaska, this is the one to book!

quotes.author: Hallwilersee
quotes.text: Unsere heutige Lake Clark Bear Viewing Tour war der Hammer. Wir haben nicht nur sehr viele Bären gesehen, sondern auch eine ganz tolle Landschaft erlebt. Auch fliegerisch inklusive 2 Landungen am Strand war die Tour ein besonderes Erlebnis. Unser Pilot und Guide Daniel war sehr kompetent, hilfsbereit, humorvoll und sympathisch. Wir haben uns jederzeit sehr sicher und wohl gefühlt. Alles war perfekt organisiert. Wir können die Tour mit Alaska Air Service uneingeschränkt empfehlen.

quotes.author: Michael Kimball
quotes.text: Alaska Air Service was fabulous to work with from beginning to end. They were attentive, responsive, and easy to deal with. Our first time on a small plane (all 4 of us) was great. Our pilot and guide, Katie, was the best. Great views, great wildlife (we flew into 2 different areas of Lake Clark National Park), and a great experience. Also, when they said robust lunch they meant it and were very accommodating for some gluten free needs. We hope to return in the not too distant future and we WILL use Alaska Air Service again. This was a fantastic day with a fantastic team! Highly recommend this company to anyone coming into Alaska wanting to see the sites! Loved it all!

quotes.author: Arthur Spencer
quotes.text: We took a day trip to Lake Clark National Park with Alaska Air Service and it was fantastic! The flights over & back were scenic and comfortable. The small plane trips are exciting. We saw lots of bears at Lake Clark. They were on the beach and in the meadows. So many great pictures! Our pilot and guide was knowledgeable and friendly. He told us so much about the area. Lunch was provided with our trip and the sandwiches were very good. We would go with Alaska Air Service again.

quotes.author: Ben Opps
quotes.text: Our family enjoyed a unique and amazing experience with Alaska Air Service that will be part of our "family story" for years to come. Bill (owner) and Katie (pilot) took amazing care of us. Very professional with a clear focus on both safety and fun. Katie narrated the flight and we learned a lot, while getting to know Alaska (and her) better. Since this was such a high ticket purchase, we shopped around in advance - we're glad we did and we made the right choice.

quotes.author: Susan Martin
quotes.text: My husband and I had time to kill during a layover in anchorage. We contacted Alaska Air Service about glacier viewing and they went out of their way to make sure we had a great experience, they picked us up at the airport and dropped us back off in time for our connecting flight. They are a great group of people and Abby is an amazing pilot, she is very knowledgeable about the area and makes the time very enjoyable. I would highly recommend doing this, and we will do it again if we ever have the opportunity.

This trip was absolutely incredible. Rusts was great! We took a small plane ride to Chinitna Bay to view bears. We landed by small Lodge & rode in a small bus. The guide was informative & knowledgeable. We were able to view multiple bears in the meadows & shore line. This trip was the highlight of our visit to Alaska. Watching the bears play and interact each other was just incredible. On the flight back, they provided a small snack. The view from the plane was great as well. This experience is an absolute must & Rusts is a great company!
